summary: A single dark modal (640x870, ~32px radius, #1d1d1d lower panel) is centred on a near-black #0a0a0a page. Its top 480px is a moody hero: a dark vignette gradient over which sits a matte black 3D card-reader (a trapezoid top deck with a long black slot and a small status LED at its lower right). Below the hero, left-aligned at x=439, come a white bold headline "Welcome to Pro, Denis", three lines of mid-grey body copy, a full-width white pill-rect CTA "Start exploring" (562x73, ~14px radius, black text) and a centred grey text link "Connect your AI agent". A close X sits top-right at (995,150). Motion: at 0.03-0.3s a white light glows along the slot. Then from 0.45s to 1.87s a holographic PRO membership card is fed up out of the slot in 6 ratchet steps, each a ~100ms jump of ~47px about every 0.25s (the card's top goes from y≈482 to 209). Meanwhile the slot keeps emitting a white glow where the card leaves it, and the LED glows amber. At 2.03-2.25s the card lifts clear of the slot, rising to top≈154 so its bottom floats ~15px above the deck, and the LED switches to green. From ~3s a cursor moves over the card and the card follows it with a small 3D perspective tilt (edges skew a few px). As it tilts, the foil's rainbow band (pink/green/violet, grainy and posterised, over a horizontally brushed silver-lilac base) slides across the card. The modal's text, button, close and reader never move.

criteria.check: Page around the modal is a flat near-black (~#0a0a0a) with no gradient or texture
Modal spans x≈400-1040 and y≈106-976 (640x870), horizontally centred in the frame
Modal corners are rounded at ~32px radius and the panel has no visible border stroke
Lower half of modal (below y≈585) is a flat dark grey ~#1d1d1d, lighter than the page
Hero area (y 106-585) is darker than the lower panel, with a soft vignette; a straight horizontal seam separates it from the lower panel at y≈585
A thin light-grey X close icon, ~18px, centred near (995,150) in the top-right of the modal
A matte black trapezoid card-reader deck sits across the hero at y≈461-510, widening from ~497-943 at its top to ~445-995 at its base
The deck has one long thin black rounded slot running ~x486-954 at y≈486
Small round LED at ~(952,548), ~8px, glowing green after the card has lifted
LED is amber/orange while the card is still feeding and turns green once the card lifts clear
Headline reads exactly "Welcome to Pro, Denis"
Headline is pure white, bold, ~34px, left edge at x≈439
Body reads "Download packs and assets, insert them in / Figma with the plugin, or let your AI agent fetch / them over MCP." broken over exactly 3 lines at those points
Body copy is mid-grey (~#9a9a9a), clearly dimmer than the white headline, ~24px regular
CTA spans x≈439-1001, y≈810-883 (562x73), aligned with the text column
CTA is a solid white fill with ~14px corner radius (rounded rect, not a full pill)
CTA label reads "Start exploring" in black semibold ~24px, centred at x≈720
Below the button, centred at x≈720 y≈921, grey text reads "Connect your AI agent" with no button background and no underline
Floating card spans ≈x495-945, y≈162-447 (≈450x285), its bottom ~15px above the reader deck
Card corners are rounded at ~16px with a thin bright rim along its edge
Card material is holographic foil: a pale silver-lilac base with fine horizontal brushed streaks plus a diagonal rainbow band (pink, mint green, violet) running from upper-middle to lower-left
The rainbow band is soft, grainy and posterised at its edges, NOT a smooth flat linear gradient with crisp hard stripes
The card has no dark outline or stroke; its edge reads as light catching a rim
Top-left of the card: a ~36px black circle holding a small white three-leaf sprout glyph at ~(539,206)
Top-right of the card reads "PRO" in dark bold caps with wide letter-spacing
Lower-left of the card reads "DENIS" in dark bold tracked caps
Under the name it reads "Member since Oct 2026" in smaller dark-grey regular type
Bottom-right of the card reads "Quarterly" in small dark-grey type, baseline level with the member line
At 0.05s no card is visible: the reader slot is empty
Between 0.05s and 0.5s a bright white glow appears along the slot, spreading wider than the slot itself, before any card shows
The card emerges from the slot top-first: at 0.5s only a ~35px sliver with "PRO" is above the slot; by 1.0s the top is at y≈366 with the logo visible
The card rises in discrete ratchet steps of ~47px (≈0.45, 0.7, 0.95, 1.22, 1.5, 1.75s, each ~100ms), holding still between steps, NOT one smooth slide
While feeding, the card's lower part is hidden inside the slot (clipped at the slot line y≈490) and a white glow lights the card where it exits
Between 1.8s and 2.25s the card lifts completely out of the slot, top going from y≈209 to ≈154, leaving a dark gap above the deck
After lifting, the card shows a small 3D perspective tilt: its top and bottom edges are slightly non-parallel (a few px skew) and the tilt changes over time
The rainbow band slides across the card as it tilts: at 4.58s it lies through the card's centre/right, at 5.9s near the top-right corner
Card tilt and foil follow the pointer; between 6.95s and 7.45s the band shifts while the card stays within ~10px of its rest box
The headline, body, CTA, link, close X and reader do not move at any point (only the card, the slot glow and the LED change)
A soft dark drop shadow sits under the floating card, with no hard edge
The reader looks like matte black plastic with a faint top-lip highlight, NOT a glossy or outlined shape
